title: The Charge of the Goddess
author: doreen-valiente
attributionNote: A modern Wiccan liturgical text associated with Doreen Valiente and earlier Gardnerian material. Its textual history and attribution are debated. It is not an ancient scripture.
description: A poetic charge used in some Wiccan rituals, invoking the Goddess and ethical norms of the craft. Versions differ across lineages and publications.
historicalContext: Composed within the mid-twentieth-century Wiccan revival, drawing on older literary and esoteric sources. Modern Wicca is historically situated and internally diverse.
availabilityNote: Catalogue record only. Modern text is under copyright and some material is lineage-restricted; no text is reproduced.
